zh.text: 美股下跌（標普500指數-0.3%，納斯達克100指數-1.0%），因$GOOG業績疲弱（-10%，AI搜尋侵蝕廣告收入）及三星（-4%，晶片未達預期及高資本支出）重新引發對AI回報的疑慮。聯準會維持利率不變，但主席Warsh因經濟強勁及通膨黏性暗示可能進一步升息。10年期公債收益率下跌2.9個基點至4.99%。布蘭特原油下跌1.6%至113美元；MSFT因第三季超預期盤前上漲4%。其他科技股落後（NVDA -0.6%，MRVL因Lumentum談判-9.8%）。比特幣下跌1.4%至8.01萬美元。標普2026年每股收益預期仍因AI支出同比+33%，但股票估值相對國債收益率偏高。

en.text: U.S. stocks fell (SPX -0.3%, NDX -1.0%) after weak results from $GOOG (-10%, AI search eroding adv revs) and Samsung (-4%, chip miss and high capex) revived doubts about AI returns. Fed held rates steady but Chair Warsh flagged further hikes on strong economy and sticky inflation. 10-year yield fell 2.9 bp to 4.99%. Brent crude dropped 1.6% to $113; MSFT rose 4% pre-market on Q3 beat. Other tech lagged (NVDA -0.6%, MRVL -9.8% on Lumentum talks). #BTC slid 1.4% to $80.1K. S&P 2026 EPS estimates remain +33% YoY on AI spend, but valuations stretched vs treasury yields.

zh.text: $ACI Albertsons Companies 行政總裁表示，經濟對許多客戶來說很艱難，燃油價格高企且通脹在損益中頑固偏高。客流量和銷量低於所需水平，整體表現未能反映資產質素或團隊能力，對結果和當前軌跡不滿意。

en.text: $ACI Albertsons Companies CEO stated the economy is tough for many customers with elevated fuel prices and stubbornly high inflation in P&L. Traffic and units below needed levels, overall performance does not reflect asset quality or team capabilities, not satisfied with results and current trajectory.

zh.text: @DiMartinoBooth 表示 Skydance 在裁員前提供自願離職方案，並實施每週5天返回辦公室；洛杉磯縣估計 Paramount 與 Warner Bros. 合併可能在3年內令洛杉磯減少4,500個影視職位。

en.text: @DiMartinoBooth says Skydance is offering voluntary buyouts ahead of layoffs and adopting 5 day in office; LA County estimated the Paramount Warner Bros. merger could cost 4,500 LA film and TV jobs over 3 years.

zh.text: $BX 黑石首席執行官史蒂夫·施瓦茨曼：過去兩年，儘管股價大幅下跌，盈利增長了近50%，股息也相應增長。標普500指數在第三季度略有上升，漲幅集中在最大的科技公司和能源板塊。儘管大多數個股下跌，中位數股票現在比近期高點低15%。

en.text: $BX Blackstone CEO Steve Schwarzman: Over the past two years, while shares are down meaningfully, earnings have grown nearly 50% with commensurate growth in dividend. The S&P 500 index rose slightly in the third quarter, with gains concentrated in the largest tech companies and the energy sector. Although most individual stocks declined, and the median stock is now 15% below its recent high.

zh.text: 超大規模雲服務商債券發行量比2024年高出近14倍，還有兩個月。據CNBC報導，亞馬遜AMZN、Meta META、Alphabet GOOG和甲骨文ORCL已發行超過2280億美元債券，超過2025年1080億美元的兩倍，以及2024年的167億美元。

en.text: Hyperscaler bond issuance is nearly 14X higher than 2024, with two months to go. Amazon $AMZN, Meta $META, Alphabet $GOOG and Oracle $ORCL have reportedly issued more than $228 billion in bonds, per CNBC, more than double the $108 billion from 2025 and the $16.7 billion from 2024.

zh.text: @APompliano 宣佈 @cfosilvia 推出以比特幣計價財富與資產的功能，認為美元貶值會扭曲財務狀況，以 $BTC 計價更能清楚反映財富增長，並附上免費試用連結。

en.text: @APompliano announces that @cfosilvia now lets users price their wealth and assets in bitcoin, arguing dollars are devalued and distort the picture of finances while denominating wealth in $BTC gives a clearer view of its growth, with a link to try it free.

zh.text: 大型石油公司第三季財報：殼牌將股份回購提高至每季約50億美元（先前約30億美元），因高油價和液化天然氣價格以及，最重要的是，創紀錄的煉油利潤率，交付了有史以來第二高的季度淨收入。$SHEL

en.text: BIG OIL 3Q EARNINGS: Shell boosts share buybacks to ~$5 billion per quarter (from a rate of ~$3 billion previously) after delivering its 2nd highest ever quarterly net income thanks to high oil and LNG prices and -- most importantly -- record refining margins. $SHEL

zh.text: Lead-Lag Report 分享更多關於 $FMKT 的詳情，位於 freemarketsetf.com。子顧問 Point Bridge、SYKON 和 Tactical Rotation Management 使用篩選工具來識別符合策略的公司，倉位由投資委員會認為最可能從去監管中受益的股票決定。

en.text: Lead-Lag Report shares more details on $FMKT at freemarketsetf.com. Subadvisors Point Bridge, SYKON, and Tactical Rotation Management use screening tools to identify companies that fit the strategy, with positions based on stocks the committee believes will benefit most from deregulation.

zh.text: 昨日股價上漲時重新做空$NBIS（新雲）。引用：Hedgeye首席執行官@KeithMcCullough表示AI泡沫已開始破裂，從新雲開始。CoreWeave於10月23日收於54.24美元，較52週高點低約62%，2032年債券收益率約15%。Gartner預期超過80%的新雲供應商將在2030年前失去獨立性。

en.text: Reloaded (shorted) on $NBIS (neocloud) on green yesterday. Quoted: Hedgeye CEO @KeithMcCullough says the AI bubble is already popping, started with the neoclouds. CoreWeave closed at $54.24 on Oct 23, about 62% below 52-week high, 2032 bonds yielding around 15%. Gartner expects >80% of neocloud providers to lose independence by 2030.
